name: aws_dynamodb_table
description: Fully managed NoSQL database table with single-digit millisecond performance at any scale

name.name: name
name.description: The name of the table (must be unique within a region)

hash_key.name: hash_key
hash_key.description: The attribute to use as the partition key (must be defined as an attribute)

range_key.name: range_key
range_key.description: The attribute to use as the sort key (must be defined as an attribute)

read_capacity.name: read_capacity
read_capacity.description: Number of read capacity units (required for PROVISIONED billing mode)

write_capacity.name: write_capacity
write_capacity.description: Number of write capacity units (required for PROVISIONED billing mode)

deletion_protection_enabled.name: deletion_protection_enabled
deletion_protection_enabled.description: Enable deletion protection for the table

stream_enabled.name: stream_enabled
stream_enabled.description: Enable DynamoDB Streams for the table

stream_view_type.name: stream_view_type
stream_view_type.description: Type of information written to the stream when an item is modified

restore_source_name.name: restore_source_name
restore_source_name.description: Name of the source table to restore from

restore_source_table_arn.name: restore_source_table_arn
restore_source_table_arn.description: ARN of the source table for cross-region restore

restore_to_latest_time.name: restore_to_latest_time
restore_to_latest_time.description: Restore to the most recent recovery point

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the table
